answer_verbatim:
If you want **online courses that are well-structured and widely surfaced in current course listings**, the strongest options from the results are **Jung Platform’s “Introduction to Jungian Shadow Work,” Awake Academy’s “Embracing the Shadow” with Charlie Morley, Insight Timer’s “Shadow Work: Embrace Your Full Self for Healing and Growth,” and Mind Is the Master’s shadow-work course roundup**.[2][9][14][1]

For a more practical shortlist, these stand out:

- **Introduction to Jungian Shadow Work** on **Jung Platform** — the title and platform positioning suggest a more explicitly Jungian, psychologically grounded approach to shadow work.[2]
- **Embracing The Shadow** with **Charlie Morley** on **Awake Academy** — likely a strong fit if you want a blend of shadow work and contemplative/spiritual practice.[9]
- **Shadow Work: Embrace Your Full Self For Healing and Growth** on **Insight Timer** — useful if you want a meditation-oriented format alongside reflection practices.[14]
- **Shadow Work: Heal & Integrate your Shadow Self** on **Udemy** — a beginner-friendly option in a large mainstream platform with broad accessibility.[3]
- **Do Your Own Shadow Work: Beginning to Advanced Practices** on **Udemy** — a better pick if you want a course that claims progression from beginner to advanced practice.[5]
- **Shadow Mastery Course & Exercises** from **Centre of Excellence** — appears more workbook/exercise focused, which may suit self-paced learning.[4]
- **Shadow Work Practitioner Online Certificate Course** from **Courses for Success** — the “certificate” framing may appeal if you want a more formalized course structure.[6]
- **Shadow Course: Discover Your Hidden Potential** from **ManTalks** — a broader personal-development framing that may be helpful if you want spiritual growth alongside shadow work.[17]

If you want a **step-by-step structured path**, the best match in the results is **Peter Paul Parker’s shadow work course hub**, which explicitly recommends starting with the **7-Day Shadow Work Online Course** as a complete guided process.[8]

A practical way to choose:

- Choose **Jung Platform** if you want the most explicitly **Jungian** framing.[2]
- Choose **Charlie Morley / Awake Academy** if you want **spiritual practice** integrated with inner work.[9]
- Choose **Insight Timer** if you prefer **meditation-based learning**.[14]
- Choose **Udemy** if you want **low-cost, beginner-friendly, self-paced** options with multiple alternatives.[3][5]
- Choose **Centre of Excellence** or **Courses for Success** if you want a more **certificate-like** or course-catalog style offering.[4][6]

If you want, I can also narrow this down into **the 5 best options specifically for spiritual practice**, **the best beginner course**, or **the best course for deep trauma-safe shadow work**.
